review_type: independent fixed-revision source/reference review, image inspection, CI status check and regression test suite audit
verdict: Round 25 achieves substantial parity advancement across both features and UI/UX. Both visible regressions introduced in round 24 are fully eliminated: tab strip labels now preserve caller view resources so zh-Hans 'Actions' translates to 动作 as in FlightData.resx, and Arabic mixed-direction runs now adhere to Unicode bidi rules so numbers and Latin acronyms maintain proper LTR ordering ('0.9500 km :المسافة' and 'عرض KML'). FlightPlanner grid column headers now use control-based lookup, rendering blank Up/Down headers matching the original WinForms resx. In features, the native plugin subsystem is operational with a C ABI (mp-plugin), PluginLoader lifecycle (Init, Loaded, Loop, Exit), PluginHost services (CurrentState, config, commands, waypoints, context menus), and a faithful PluginManager (Ctrl+P) UI with status coloring and error diagnostics. GimbalVideoControl is fully ported with Full Sized (with mini map overlay), Mini, and Pop Out modes, map context submenu, payload tab button integration, and camera/gimbal context commands. Furthermore, HUD GStreamer now maintains an independent video source from MJPEG with cancellation support in the download dialog, the MAVLink 2/4 identity sighting rule is implemented, and CurrentState getters (alt-derivative verticalspeed and reverse thrust throttle) match reference behavior. All 162 workspace tests pass.

scores.scale: Qualitative exact-original parity scores on a 0-10 scale, not feature completion percentages. Overall equally weights UI/UX and features (9.2). UI/UX credits the resolution of the tab strip caller bug, the working Arabic bidi implementation, and control-keyed FlightPlanner headers. Features credits the native plugin subsystem, the GimbalVideoControl subsystem with Full Sized/Mini/Pop Out modes, GStreamer source isolation with download cancellation, MAVLink 2/4 vehicle selection, and CurrentState alt-derivative verticalspeed/ch3percent reverse thrust. Scores are held back by mobile packaging/runtime verification, missing CI runs on unpushed local commits, and remaining native transports (BLE, WinUSB, Android USB serial).

rationale: Localization & UI: In 46a8faa, theme::tab_strip and tab_strip_multiline replace closure mapping with an explicit for loop. Because #[track_caller] does not propagate through closures, this allows Location::caller() to correctly resolve the caller view (flight_data.rs), returning 动作 for zh-Hans tabActions instead of falling back to English (verified in render 58). Arabic bidi ordering is solved in i18n.rs with visual() implementing W2, W4, N1/N2, and L2 rules, while fonts.rs keeps Latin and Arabic in distinct font faces so egui shapes each direction properly; render 62 confirms '0.9500 km :المسافة' and 'عرض KML' retain logical ordering rather than reversed characters. FlightPlanner grid headers map control names via export_translations.py, correctly leaving Up/Down empty (render 60) per FlightPlanner.resx. Plugins: 98001c3 introduces crates/mp-plugin and crates/mp-app/src/plugins.rs. The C ABI exports mp_plugin_entry(api_version, host, out), providing thread-safe Host callbacks for cs_field, config_get/set, do_command, add_wp, add_menu, and log. PluginLoader mirrors PluginLoader.cs: libraries are scanned in plugins/, Init filters active plugins, Loaded runs once all are initialized, Loop executes at loop_rate_hz on a dedicated background thread, and Exit executes on shutdown. DisabledPlugins comma-separated list is respected. PluginManager (hotkey_tools.rs, Ctrl+P) replicates PluginUI.cs in a 673x373 window with Save & Close, Show Errors, and colored rows (green=active, orange=disabled, dark red=missing/unloadable). Clear diagnostics explain why .NET assemblies or .cs files cannot be loaded. Gimbal Video: 1dff23b and 642db86 port Controls/GimbalVideoControl.cs and FlightData.cs:6666-6845. GimbalPlacement supports FullSized (with mini map overlay), Mini (docked on map), and PopOut (independent 'Gimbal Control' window). BUT_GimbalVideo in fd_tabs.rs Payload tab switches to PopOut mode (render 40). Context menus on the video box support Retract (cmd 205), Neutral, Point Down, Point Home (cmd 195 ROI), Yaw Lock, Take Picture (cmd 2000), Start/Stop Recording (cmd 2500/2501), Shortcuts modal, Custom Settings modal (HFOV/VFOV), and mini map swap/close. GStreamer: FlightDataView now holds a separate gst: Option<Mjpeg> slot from MJPEG video. GStreamer Stop and prompt cancellation only stop gst (FlightData.cs:4979-4982). GStreamer download window includes a Cancel button, calling download_cancellable with an atomic cancel flag reporting 'User Request' (render 61). MAVLink & State: a3f8bab implements MAVLinkInterface.cs:921-923 getHeartBeat hbhistory rule (preference compid 1 seen >= 2, failover to any compid seen >= 4, counting HEARTBEAT and HIGH_LATENCY2). 0f657de ports CurrentState.cs:336-349 alt setter: verticalspeed is computed from altitude differences with dt >= 0.2s; climbrate updates from verticalspeed only until VFR_HUD is received (got_vfr guard); ch3percent applies the REVERSE_MOTOR (1<<23) bitmask inversion.

ten_out_of_ten_criterion: An honest 10 requires no known material software discrepancy within the promised exact-clone scope, plus adequate interaction and native-platform evidence. Round 25 closes both Round 24 localization regressions (tab strips, Arabic bidi), ports GimbalVideoControl across Full Sized, Mini and Pop Out modes, introduces the native plugin subsystem with PluginManager UI and background execution, separates GStreamer HUD streaming with download cancellation, and implements MAVLink 2/4 identity selection and CurrentState alt-derivative verticalspeed. Reaching 10 requires verifying the mobile runtime (Android APK and iOS bundle), pushing and verifying CI on latest commits, adding platform transports (BLE, WinUSB, Android USB serial), and integrating GDAL/geocoder capabilities. Physical flight qualification is separate from this software parity score.
